author: carwow
description:
Is BMW’s B58 engine the greatest engine of all time? 

Explore new and used car deals with Carwow: https://bit.ly/Change-Your-Car-07-11

It’s time for a B58 head-to-head! 

While all four cars in this line-up may seem vastly different to each other, they have one thing in common - under each of their bonnets is a BMW B58 engine! 

This 3-litre straight-six turbo may be one of the most famous engines around, but how does it fare when used across four different cars? It’s time to find out! 

First up we have the Morgan Supersport 400. Here the B58 produces 408hp and 500Nm, with this power sent to the rear wheels only via an 8-speed automatic gearbox. It’s by far the lightest car here, at just 1,170kg, but it’s also easily the most expensive, costing a colossal £138,883! 

Alongside it we have the BMW M240i. This B58 produces 392hp and 540Nm, but unlike the Morgan, this power is sent to all four wheels! It tips the scales at 1,690kg, and it costs around £50,000.

title: World's greatest engine: DRAG RACE
